entity_types.name: GovernmentOfficial
entity_types.description: High-level political figures and decision-makers involved in statecraft and national policy.

attributes.name: official_title
attributes.description: The specific rank or position held within the government.

attributes.name: political_affiliation
attributes.description: The political party or faction the official belongs to.

entity_types.name: MilitaryCommander
entity_types.description: Leaders of armed forces responsible for border security, discipline, and tactical operations.

attributes.name: military_rank
attributes.description: The formal rank held by the commander.

attributes.name: operational_zone
attributes.description: The specific geographic area or border sector under their command.

examples: General of the Royal Cambodian Army

entity_types.name: Diplomat
entity_types.description: Representatives tasked with international relations, negotiations, and managing the global image.

attributes.name: mission_location
attributes.description: The country or international body where the diplomat is stationed.

attributes.name: diplomatic_specialty
attributes.description: The specific area of focus, such as border disputes or trade.

entity_types.name: Journalist
entity_types.description: Media professionals who report on leaks, military clashes, and political developments.

attributes.name: media_outlet
attributes.description: The news organization or platform the journalist writes for.

attributes.name: reporting_focus
attributes.description: The primary subject matter covered by the journalist.

entity_types.name: CulturalInfluencer
entity_types.description: Public figures who shape opinion on shared heritage, national pride, and historical identity.

attributes.name: influence_platform
attributes.description: The primary social media platform used by the influencer.

attributes.name: cultural_niche
attributes.description: The specific aspect of culture or history they focus on.

entity_types.name: BusinessLeader
entity_types.description: Individuals managing enterprises, including those in border zones or controversial sectors.

attributes.name: industry_type
attributes.description: The sector of the economy the leader operates in.

attributes.name: business_region
attributes.description: The primary geographic area of business operations.

entity_types.name: AcademicScholar
entity_types.description: Experts in history, archaeology, and political science who analyze civilizational roots.

attributes.name: field_of_expertise
attributes.description: The specific academic discipline of the scholar.

attributes.name: institutional_affiliation
attributes.description: The university or research center they are associated with.

entity_types.name: Activist
entity_types.description: Individuals or group leaders advocating for accountability, peace, or specific national causes.

attributes.name: advocacy_goal
attributes.description: The primary objective or change the activist is seeking.

attributes.name: movement_name
attributes.description: The name of the organization or movement they lead.

entity_types.name: Person
entity_types.description: Fallback type for any natural person not fitting specific categories, such as netizens.

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: The full name of the individual.

attributes.name: bio_description
attributes.description: A brief biography or self-description.

entity_types.name: Organization
entity_types.description: Fallback type for any group, NGO, or entity not fitting specific categories.

attributes.name: org_name
attributes.description: The formal name of the organization.

attributes.name: headquarters_location
attributes.description: The city or country where the organization is based.

edge_types.name: CRITICIZES
edge_types.description: Expresses disapproval or points out faults in another entity's actions or statements.

edge_types.name: NEGOTIATES_WITH
edge_types.description: Engages in formal or informal discussions to resolve conflicts or reach agreements.

edge_types.name: ACCUSES
edge_types.description: Claims that another entity is responsible for a specific wrongdoing or mistake.

edge_types.name: REPORTS_ON
edge_types.description: Provides news coverage or factual accounts regarding an entity or event.

edge_types.name: ADVOCATES_FOR
edge_types.description: Publicly supports a cause, policy, or specific entity's position.

edge_types.name: WORKS_FOR
edge_types.description: Indicates employment or official service within an organization or government.

edge_types.name: APPEALS_TO
edge_types.description: Makes a request or plea to another entity based on shared values or universal truths.

edge_types.name: REPRESENTS
edge_types.description: Acts as the official voice or agent for a larger group or nation.

analysis_summary: The ontology is designed to simulate the complex Thailand-Cambodia relationship in 2026, focusing on the tension between military conflict, diplomatic negotiation, and shared cultural history. It includes specific roles for those involved in border clashes (MilitaryCommander), the 'scam center' controversy (BusinessLeader), and the historical/cultural debate (AcademicScholar, CulturalInfluencer). The relationships focus on the 'he-said she-said' loop of accusations and the proposed shift toward accountability and soft diplomacy.
simulation_requirement: anayalyse Thailand Cambodia politic and relationship 2026
